title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in it. The live paper record is a log of signals, not a portfolio, and one trade does not say anything about a strategy.

## Open positions, closed trades, and the first signals

The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The entry, the exit rule, the exit price, and the net result are all recorded as they happened.

A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. No exit is recorded for that position, so no result is available from the live record.

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper and 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper and 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade. These counts and averages are the recorded closed-trade figures at the snapshot time.

v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The closed-trade averages are negative for both trend-daily engines, with sample sizes of 6 and 7 trades. The record states these figures as measured. It does not turn them into a forecast.

In testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. That is the stated expectation behind the record, not a claim that any future trade will follow it.

## What the market filter is allowing

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off and 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off and 0 positions open on paper. The record states the filter state and the position count. It does not state a reason for the filter being off.

The names closest to their 20-day breakout are recorded as follows. ZECUSDT is 8.28% below its high. TRXUSDT is 9.36% below its high. BNBUSDT is 9.82% below its high. These are distance measurements from the current snapshot, not statements about whether a breakout will occur.

## Reading the record without projection

Every figure here is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The ATOM result, the NEAR open position, the closed-trade counts, the averages, and the breakout distances all describe signal history and engine state, not a portfolio.

The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-09T20:50:59.420Z.

A single trade says nothing about a strategy. A short live record with 0 open positions and negative closed-trade averages is still only a short live record. The proper reading is descriptive: what is open, what closed, what the filter is doing, and what the measurements show at the time of the snapshot.
